title: Audit learner BJT levels index screen

spec.problem: The active /:locale/levels page and homepage roadmap section request GET /api/levels, but the Go router has no collection handler. The levels page therefore cannot show its six BJT levels; where content renders, it also uses Vietnamese metadata and hard-coded English copy across locales.

acceptance.text: Anonymous GET /api/levels returns all six canonical BJT levels in J5-to-J1+ order, with active vocabulary/kanji/grammar counts and localized name/description fields; J1+ does not alias N1.
The /:locale/levels screen displays all six levels in vi, en, and ja using localized names, descriptions, readiness/assessment copy, and error/empty states; level links preserve locale.
The homepage BJT level section uses the same public API and locale-aware level names; canonical vocabulary, kanji, and grammar remain read-only.
The page distinguishes an analytics request failure from a learner with no completed sessions, without silently discarding the failure.
At 390x844 the anonymous levels screen renders without horizontal overflow, with all six level links reachable and no unresolved console/network errors.

spec.expected_behavior: GET /api/levels returns canonical ordered BJT level summaries with active master-data counts; learner levels and homepage links render and navigate in each supported locale, with user-facing copy localized and analytics failures distinguished from empty history.
spec.observed_behavior: LevelsClient fetches /api/levels and enters an error state on 404; BjtLevelsSection suppresses itself on the same missing endpoint. LevelsClient renders nameVi/descriptionVi for every locale and embeds English-only readiness/assessment text.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the new public collection handler, locale label fields, and screen copy/test changes together; keep the existing individual level-detail APIs unchanged.

classification.rationale: Fix the levels screen and stabilize its browser acceptance by serializing smoke tests against shared Next dev caches; keep canonical content read-only.

red_targets.test: LevelsClient > renders localized levels and actions for en
BjtLevelsSection > loads the shared collection and uses the selected locale
LevelsClient > hides the empty-history prompt when analytics fails
red_targets.expect: Empty-history CTA is shown after analytics failure

risk_acknowledgements.reason: Only the worker count changes: all Playwright tests remain collected, and serial execution prevents a reproduced concurrent-write corruption of the shared Admin Next dev prerender manifest. CI was already configured for one worker.
